proposal.blind_spot: The metrics could not reveal whether the high DRAM pressure came mainly from global reads, global writes, or materialized intermediate traffic.

rationale.dram__bytes_read.sum: HIGH -> fuse producer and consumer operations and reuse data to eliminate redundant global loads; LOW -> prioritize store reduction or launch-geometry changes instead of load elimination.
rationale.dram__bytes_write.sum: HIGH -> avoid materializing intermediates and fuse output-producing passes to reduce global stores; LOW -> prioritize reducing global reads and improving scheduling or computation.
